Subject: VAT on upcoming invoice (reverse-charge) — please advise

Hi Hannah,

We have a Redwood invoice coming for June usage and we need to confirm VAT treatment for our Polish reseller entity. We are a non-taxable person in Poland for the supply of digital services to business customers, but our accounting team asked for confirmation that Redwood will apply reverse-charge (net invoice) and that Redwood has validated our EU VAT ID.

What we can share now:
- VAT ID: PL1234567890 (attached screenshot)
- Company registration name: OliveTech Sp. z o.o.
- Our portal requires an invoice that shows 0% VAT with a note: "Reverse charge — Article 196 VAT Directive"

Can you confirm you can:
1) Validate the VAT ID and acceptance via VIES or equivalent
2) Issue the June invoice net of VAT with the reverse-charge wording we provided
3) Temporarily lift the payment hold once the invoice is reissued (we're ready to pay)

Thanks — we have a month-end payment window and would like to avoid delays.

Best,
Anna
Finance Manager
OliveTech

Hi — I ran the VAT ID through VIES at 10:10 CET and received an "active" status for PL1234567890. Saved a screenshot to our tax folder (see drive link). A few notes and options:

- VIES result: active (matches company name OliveTech Sp. z o.o.). This is sufficient for standard RC (reverse-charge) B2B treatment in the EU.
- If VIES intermittently fails at settlement time we should fall back to the national registry extract (the PNG Anna attached) — keep it on file.
- Required invoice language: include both the local reference and the EU directive note. Suggested wording: "VAT reverse-charge applies. Customer is liable for VAT (Article 196 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC). VAT ID verified via VIES on 2026-06-30."

Action items I recommend:
1) Reissue invoice net of VAT with the exact wording above.
2) Add reference to our tax evidence bundle id: TAX-EVID-20260630-OLV (internal).
3) Collections: release the payment hold after invoice reissue and mark as pending payment for 5 business days.

I'll attach the VIES lookup screenshot to our evidence bundle and include the national registry image Anna provided.
